entry.author: City Rail Link
entry.summary:
In the fourth of our five-part series on the History of CRL, discover the stations that change everything.

The twin 3.45-kilometre-long tunnels which have been built up to 42 metres below the Auckland City Centre connect the refurbished Waitematā Station on Auckland's waterfront with a re-developed Maungawhau Station in uptown.

Two new underground stations open up central city access; Karanga-a-Hape with entrances at Mercury Lane and Beresford Square and Te Waihorotiu at Victoria and Wellesley Streets in midtown.
